answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must register by burning cryptographic stake that scales superlinearly: minting the nth identity burns $C_0 \cdot n^{1.5}$ stake tokens permanently. This creates insurmountable economic friction where attacking cost grows superlinearly, rendering mass spoofing mathematically unviable. The network burns tokens across distinct environmental tiers: dense basalt substrate nodes, frozen tundra archival clusters, and visual pigment verification layers.
